guide.title: The Quarry at Giants Ridge: Golf in Biwabik, Minnesota
guide.intro: Golf Digest's 2025-'26 Best in State ranking for Minnesota places The Quarry at Giants Ridge sixth, labelled "Public." Five higher-ranked entries were passed over to reach it, all labelled "Private": #1 Interlachen Country Club (Edina), #2 Spring Hill Golf Club (Wayzata), #3 Hazeltine National Golf Club (Chaska), #4 White Bear Yacht Club (White Bear Lake) and #5 The Minikahda Club (Minneapolis). The Quarry, designed by Jeffrey D. Brauer, ASGCA, is one of two golf courses at Giants Ridge in Biwabik, St. Louis County, Minnesota — the St. Louis County in the northeastern part of the state, not the county of the same name in Missouri. Golf Digest also ranks the course #58 on its 2025-'26 America's 100 Greatest Public Courses list. This guide is about the course that placed sixth.

sections.heading: Getting there
sections.body: The Quarry at Giants Ridge is at 6383 Wynne Creek Dr, Biwabik, MN 55708, in St. Louis County, Minnesota. By road to the course: Minneapolis-St. Paul International Airport is 211 miles, south; Duluth International Airport is 67 miles, southeast; Range Regional Airport, in Hibbing, is 35 miles, southwest.

sections.heading: The Quarry at Giants Ridge
sections.body: Jeffrey D. Brauer, ASGCA designed The Quarry: 18 holes, 7,201 yards, a slope of 139, and Golf Digest lists the facility type as Public. Golf Digest's Best in State list ranked the course fourth from 2011 through 2022 and has ranked it sixth since 2023, matching its current 2025-'26 position. The same publication ranks it #58 on its 2025-'26 America's 100 Greatest Public Courses list; its highest ranking there was 16th, in 2005-'06 and again in 2011-'12. Golf Digest's own description: "It doesn't get the press that courses such as Bandon Dunes, Pacific Dunes, Whistling Straits or Arcadia Bluffs, but The Quarry at Giants Ridge plays very links-like with its collection of fairway speed slots, greenside backboards and backstops and reverse-camber greens. It's very inventive design also demands some aerial play, too. A standout is its 13th, a drivable par-4 that's nearly as wide as it is long, with three alternate routes to a 100-yard-wide green. We named it the best 13th hole in America built since 2000."

sections.heading: Playing it
sections.body: Tee times at The Quarry are booked by telephone only, at (218) 865-8030; the operator's own "Book Tee Times" buttons on its website dial that number rather than opening an online tee sheet, and the same is true of the "Tee Times" links elsewhere on the site. The operator's rate table, current as of a September 5, 2026 reading of its own site, runs in four seasonal bands for 2026: Early Season, from an opening date the operator lists only as "TBD" through May 28, at $100 weekend and weekday; Prime Season, May 29 through August 23, at $130; Fall Season, August 24 through September 27, at $130; and Late Season, September 28 through October 11, 2026, at $100 — the last date the operator prices golf in 2026. A same-day replay costs $75 in the Early, Fall and Late bands. Twilight play is $100 after 3 p.m. in Prime Season and after 2 p.m. in Fall Season. Junior golfers, age 17 and under and accompanied by an adult, pay $45 in every band. A military rate is offered; the operator requires photo ID to receive it and does not publish its price. All rates include a golf car and range balls, per the operator's own footnote. Cancellations require at least 48 hours' advance notice. No membership is required to play, and Golf Digest independently labels the facility "Public."

sections.heading: Day two: The Legend at Giants Ridge
sections.body: The Legend at Giants Ridge is Golf Digest's 22nd-ranked course on the same Minnesota list, also labelled "Public," in Biwabik. Golf Digest's own entry credits it to "Texas-based architect Jeff Brauer" — the same architect as The Quarry. The operator states The Legend opened in 1997. The Legend shares The Quarry's 2026 rate table and its phone-only booking rule: "Please call 218-865-8030 for tee times."

sections.heading: Around Giants Ridge
sections.body: On-site lodging at Giants Ridge includes The Lodge, The Villas and Greengate Guesthouse, named in the resort's own site navigation under Lodging. On-site dining includes Burnt Onion Kitchen & Brews and the Wacootah Grille; the Wacootah Grille sits at The Quarry's clubhouse and overlooks the 18th green. Bunkers Snack Bar sits at the turn between the first and ninth holes of The Legend, and the operator states it opens at 6 a.m. daily through the golf season. What these sources establish is that these places exist, what they serve or offer, and — for the Wacootah Grille and Bunkers — where on the property they sit; none of them says whether any given venue is trading this week, so this guide does not say so either.

faq.question: How do I book a tee time at The Quarry?
faq.answer: By telephone only, at (218) 865-8030. The operator's own "Book Tee Times" buttons dial that number rather than opening an online tee sheet, and there is no online tee sheet anywhere on the operator's site. Cancellations require at least 48 hours' advance notice — that rule governs cancelling a tee time already booked, not the notice needed to book one.

faq.question: What does a round cost?
faq.answer: From the operator's own 2026 rate table, read September 5, 2026: $100 weekend and weekday in Early Season (opening date listed only as "TBD" through May 28) and in Late Season (September 28 through October 11, 2026); $130 weekend and weekday in Prime Season (May 29 through August 23) and Fall Season (August 24 through September 27). A same-day replay is $75 outside Prime Season. Juniors, 17 and under with an adult, pay $45 in every band. All rates include a golf car and range balls.

faq.question: When does the 2026 season end?
faq.answer: The operator's 2026 rate table's last band, Late Season, runs September 28 through October 11, 2026 — the last date it prices golf for the year. The season's opening date is listed only as "TBD."

faq.question: Where is The Quarry?
faq.answer: At 6383 Wynne Creek Dr, Biwabik, MN 55708, in St. Louis County, Minnesota — not the county of the same name in Missouri. By road: Minneapolis-St. Paul International Airport is 211 miles, south; Duluth International Airport is 67 miles, southeast; Range Regional Airport, in Hibbing, is 35 miles, southwest.

faq.question: Which course should I play on day two?
faq.answer: The Legend at Giants Ridge, ranked 22nd on the same Golf Digest Minnesota list and also labelled "Public." It shares The Quarry's 2026 rate table and the same phone-only booking rule, at (218) 865-8030.
